links.name: PUBLISHES
links.fact: The IEA's most recent outlook 'Key Questions on Energy and AI' (2026) states global data centre electricity consumption was 485 TWh in 2025, roughly doubling to about 950 TWh in 2030 (~3% of global electricity demand), with 2025 demand growth of 17% and AI-focused data centre consumption tripling between 2025 and 2030.

links.name: CUSTOMER_OF
links.fact: Meta's 20-year PPA with Constellation covers the entire output of the Illinois nuclear power plant.

links.name: REPORTS_ON
links.fact: CNBC reported that Amazon shares fell amid rising capex scrutiny after Alphabet raised its 2026 outlook in July 2026.

links.name: INFLUENCES
links.fact: SemiAnalysis countered BNEF-style cancellation-risk framings, arguing that 'half cancelled' framings overstate risk by sampling the most cancellation-prone pipeline slice.

links.name: PARALLEL_AGENCY_DEMAND_OUTLOOKS
links.fact: The IEA's central projection of 485 TWh datacenter electricity consumption in 2025 growing to about 950 TWh by 2030 is cross-referenced against observed EIA retail sales data, which showed US total commercial sector electricity sales up 4.306% year-over-year in July 2026, indicating strain rather than surge.

links.name: ALSO_KNOWN_AS
links.fact: Amazon (AWS) 亦称 Amazon

links.name: ACCELERATES
links.fact: GE Vernova's 2026 full-year total relative to 2025's full-year total is a leading indicator monitored alongside Dominion's contracted data-center pipeline growth through Q1 2027 results

links.name: INFLUENCES
links.fact: The widely cited ~$1.65 trillion Nikkei Asia figure includes Oracle among five companies, combining uncommenced leases, commitments, guarantees and JV exposures rather than a four-company capex total

links.name: CONSTRAINS
links.fact: PJM wholesale prices rose 41 percent in 2026, with the gap between datacenter power demand and deployable supply in the Virginia load pocket clearing through price and delay, gating capex-to-capacity conversion.

links.name: REPORTS_ON
links.fact: Utility Dive reported that GE Vernova expected to end 2025 with an ~80 GW turbine backlog stretching into 2029, with slot reservations sold out through 2030 by end-2026.

links.name: FORECASTS
links.fact: The EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook of October 6, 2026 forecasts US commercial-sector electricity demand (which includes data centers) to grow 2.8% year-over-year in 2027.

links.name: PARTNERS_WITH
links.fact: GE Vernova's marketing claims a partnership with Chevron to deliver 4 GW of power by 2027, using containerized fast-start gas units advertised as powering a site in "2 weeks".

links.name: EXECUTIVE_OF
links.fact: Scott Strazik is CEO of GE Vernova, where as of Q1 2026 he put directional lead times on new heavy-duty turbine orders at about three years — an order placed in 2026 delivers after 2027 — while cautioning the turbine is often not a project's binding constraint.

links.name: FORECASTS_CAP_OF
links.fact: In August 2026, JP Morgan forecast big-tech AI capex of at least $1.0tn for 2027, covering Microsoft.

links.name: REPORTS_ON
links.fact: The Financial Times reported on prices of bonds issued to fund prominent data centres, including Meta's debt financing.

links.name: REPORTS_ON
links.fact: The EIA October 2026 STEO reports wholesale prices averaging $52/MWh in 2026 (+11%), with PJM up 41%, easing to $49/MWh in 2027.
